local_review.finding_body: The contribution added --enable-preview to Java compilation, JVM execution, and Native Image build configuration solely to support a rewritten experimental-ASM test path. That necessity originated in test code, not AspectJ or a transitive dependency, violating the native flag rule in FS-test-contract.2.7 and broadening the compile repair beyond the changed Optional-return API contrary to FS-test-contract.2.9.
local_review.finding_title: Test-only preview configuration broadened a javac repair
local_review.fix_note: Removed the test-originated preview configuration, restored AjOrgObjectwebAsmConstantsTest to the existing non-preview behavior, and regenerated stats. The intended SimpleCache Optional adaptation remains intact, all coverage scopes match the previous version, and finalization passes cleanly.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the target-coordinate-only diff, the javac repair for SimpleCache.getAndInitialize returning Optional<byte[]>, index integrity, metadata format, test behavior, and old/new dynamic-access statistics. After repair, overall coverage is 153/157 (97.4522%), reflection is 137/140 (97.8571%), and resources is 16/17 (94.1176%), exactly matching 1.9.21.1 and passing every ordered repair comparison. Forge finalization then passed the current-defaults latest-GraalVM, future-defaults latest-GraalVM, and current-defaults GraalVM 25 lanes, metadata checks, style checks, test-only metadata splitting, and statistics generation, and a second complete run made no further publishable change.
